A project's optional "links" ({label, url}) show under its title.
name: Aditya Singh

points: Built and deployed a Python/Streamlit billing tool that prices CEVA Logistics shipments against the full contract tariff (5 zones × 5 weight brackets, minimum charges, out-of-area, 6 accessorials, wait time, fuel surcharge), cutting per-shipment pricing from ~4 minutes to under 30 seconds and saving ~10 hours/week.

Engineered a waybill PDF parser (pdfplumber, pyzbar) using region-cropped text extraction and barcode decoding to auto-fill weight, tracking number, and addresses across multi-page daily batches, with deduplication and low-confidence flagging.
Added CSV manifest ingestion with geocoded distance estimates (Nominatim, OSRM) and manual override, exporting CEVA’s original manifest with appended charge columns for invoicing 175+ shipments/week.
Built a scheduling tool (Google Calendar API, Apps Script) coordinating 20+ vehicle calendars, reducing double-bookings from ~10% to zero.
Automated per-vehicle Google Drive folder creation and linking in Python/Apps Script, saving ~15 hours/month (~$3.2K/year in labour).
Cut company website load time by 25% for 250+ weekly visitors via image compression, plugin cleanup, and caching; handled 50+ customer inquiries/week (60+ five-star Google reviews).

projects.name: CounterPick
points: Built a Pick’Em optimizer for CS2 Majors: a joint Bradley-Terry model fits team strengths from bookmaker odds, and a vectorized NumPy Swiss simulator runs 100,000 stages in about 1.1 seconds under Valve’s rulebook.
Searched 10,090,080 legal cards with greedy and local search to maximize the chance of 5+ correct picks, re-scoring finalists on a holdout batch; the top 5 matched a brute-force search exactly.
Validated by replaying the Austin 2025 Major, reproducing every pairing and published Buchholz score; 222 tests under strict mypy and ruff.

projects.name: Meruem Chess Coach
projects.stack: JavaScript, Stockfish (WASM), ONNX Runtime Web, Claude API
points: Built a browser chess trainer that grades every move from Best to Blunder with Stockfish 17.1 in Web Workers, using Lichess’s win-probability curve.
Ran the Maia-3 neural network in the browser through ONNX Runtime to give an adaptive opponent that plays like real players at the user’s rating.
Added an opening explorer covering 3,865 named positions, board analysis (pins, forks, loose pieces), and Claude explanations grounded by a tool that runs Stockfish on any move it cites.

projects.name: Load Balancer & Rate Limiter
points: Built a reverse-proxy load balancer on raw TCP sockets using only the standard library, with round-robin and least-connections routing, 500 ms active health checks, and transparent failover retry.
Sustained 1,671 req/s at 36 ms p99 latency with 100% success, including a run with one of three backends killed mid-test.
Implemented per-client token-bucket and sliding-window-log rate limiting; 59% of an abusive client’s burst was rejected with 429 while 20 concurrent clients kept 100% success.

projects.name: UFC FightIQ
points: Built a fight-outcome predictor on 5,000+ bouts with a custom ELO engine (finish-weighted K-factors, inactivity decay) and momentum features feeding a Random Forest classifier; 58.8% accuracy backtested over 2010–2025.
Automated data collection with a BeautifulSoup scraper into SQLite, served through an interactive Streamlit matchup dashboard.
